name: Tsubaki Hirofumi
source:
A member of the imperial capital's Ministry of Home Affairs. A young gentleman. One of a few of [url=https://vndb.org/c48874]Inami[/url]'s friends.

A mild-mannered, common-sense man. It's unusual for someone like him to be the [url=https://vndb.org/c48874]protagonist[/url]'s friend. Tsubaki is also one of the few individuals who can advise or admonish [url=https://vndb.org/c48874]Inami[/url]. He also has a wife.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.liar.co.jp/raiL/sanzinkou_chara.html]official site[/url]]
